explication: ncnn is a cross-platform neural-network inference framework, with CPU and Vulkan execution and a Python binding. The principal workflow is to convert a trained model (the README recommends PyTorch through pnnx), load its parameter and weight files into ncnn, provide input tensors, and extract output tensors. The repository also includes other format converters, optimization and quantization tools, and Python model-zoo helpers. Runtime internals are summarized by their tensor, layer, device, and pipeline responsibilities. Some tool and model-zoo links are documented only at repository level; those relationships are shown as unverified where source evidence is absent.
